pkgmetadata.longdescription: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents: each agent runs in a kernel-isolated sandbox (Landlock, seccomp, network fencing) under a declarative policy; the gateway control plane brokers credentials only to approved endpoints, and formally verified policy changes prevent risky access grants. The package installs the openshell CLI, the openshell-gateway local control plane, the policy prover, and the sandbox and supervisor binaries, plus an OpenRC user service for the gateway (start with rc-service --user openshell-gateway).
